newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst reshuffles management board jobs.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst reshuffles management board jobs.

text.p: Hoechst AG, Germany's largest chemicals and drugs group, on Wednesday announced another shift of responsibilities of its management board, prompted by the resignation of two members.
Karl-Gerhard Seifert, formerly in charge of speciality chemicals and diagnostics, has left the board to become chairman of Clariant AG.
Ernest Drew, formerly in charge of chemicals, technical Polymers and North America, will leave to become chairman of U.S. group Westinghouse's Industries and Technology group.
The new responsibilities are as follows:
Hoechst management board chairman Juergen Dormann will head management development and public communication.
Former personnel director Utz-Hellmuth Felcht will be in charge of Celanese, the group's chemicals business, Ticona, technical plastics and Herberts, coatings busines.
Justus Mische will be in charge of Trevira, the group's polyester business.
Ernst Schadow will become personnel director and in charge of the plastics businesses, the Messer group, Corporate Research & Technology.
Klaus-Juergen Schmieder will remain chief financial officer, head of corporate controlling and development and corporate accounting.
Claudio Sonder will be in charge of crops protection unit AgrEvo, Hoechst Roussel Vet, Nutrition and procurement.
Horst Waesche will remain in charge of the drugs business Hoechst Marion Roussel and Behring Diagnostics.
